title: Cafe del Mar Beach Club (Phuket)
description: Experience the legendary Ibiza beach club culture successfully transplanted to Kamala Beach. Fire shows, VIP cabanas, and world-class international deep.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Cafe del Mar Phuket, located on Kamala Beach, offers a luxury, high-energy beach club experience with VIP cabanas, a central pool, and professional fire dancers. It operates year-round, requiring advance booking.
> *   The venue transitions from sunset cocktails to a high-energy outdoor club featuring international deep house DJs, providing a 4+ hour experience with low physical demand.
> *   Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers, ensuring a seamless, high-standard experience for clients.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Experience the legendary Ibiza beach club culture successfully transplanted to Kamala Beach. Fire shows, VIP cabanas, and world-class international deep house DJs create a sophisticated yet electrifying atmosphere. This is the ultimate post-golf wind-down for groups looking to celebrate a successful day on Phuket's championship fairways.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Recognizing that Phuket needed an upscale, energetic alternative to the chaotic Bangla Road, the globally famous Cafe del Mar brand built a staggering bamboo-and-thatch club right on the sand. The architecture reflects a blend of Mediterranean chic and Thai tropical elegance. The operators brought the iconic sound of Ibiza to the Andaman Sea, ensuring that the music, service, and ambiance mirror the uncompromising standards of their flagship locations.

## What to Expect
Upon arrival, you are escorted past the general admission queues to a reserved VIP daybed or private cabana near the massive central pool. The afternoon begins with a laid-back, sophisticated vibe. Signature cocktails, premium bottle service, and a curated menu of Mediterranean and Thai fusion dishes are delivered by attentive staff.

As the sun sets over the Andaman Sea, the venue transforms into a high-energy outdoor club. The tempo increases, and the legendary Cafe del Mar resident and guest DJs take over, spinning deep house and techno. Professional fire dancers perform intricate routines right on the shoreline, lighting up the beach and adding a theatrical element to the night. The transition from a relaxed afternoon lounge to an electrifying nightspot is seamless, offering a dynamic 4+ hour experience.

## Nearby Accommodations
For groups wanting to stay close to the action, Kamala Beach and the surrounding areas offer exceptional luxury accommodations:
* **Andara Resort & Villas** — Ultra-luxury private pool villas overlooking the bay, perfect for golf groups demanding privacy and five-star service.
* **Twinpalms Phuket** — A chic, contemporary resort located slightly south on Surin Beach, known for its outstanding dining and sleek design.
* **InterContinental Phuket Resort** — Situated right on Kamala Beach, offering immediate access to Cafe del Mar along with world-class spa facilities and dining.

## Insider Tips for Golfers
* **Timing is Everything:** Book a morning tee time at nearby Red Mountain Golf Club or Laguna Golf Phuket, allowing you to return to your villa, refresh, and arrive at Cafe del Mar by 4:30 PM to secure the best sunset views.
* **Dress for the Transition:** Smart casual is universally respected. Tailored shorts and a premium polo transition perfectly from a late afternoon lounge to the evening party.
* **Hydration and Recovery:** After a round of golf in the tropical heat, leverage the club's premium food and beverage service to refuel. The ocean breeze and relaxed setting are ideal for post-round recovery.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Arrive in the late afternoon and occupy a reserved VIP daybed near the massive central pool. Enjoy sunset cocktails while discussing the day's best shots. At night, the venue transforms into a high-energy outdoor club. A heavy rotation of famous international DJs provides the soundtrack as you party under the stars, making it a highlight of any Phuket golf trip.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details | AGS Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Glamorous, High-Energy, Tropical | Perfect for post-round celebration |
| **Duration** | 4+ Hours | Flexible depending on group energy |
| **Physical Demand** | Low | Ideal after walking 18 holes |
| **Best Paired With** | A weekend blowout | Pair with Red Mountain Golf Club |
| **Location** | Kamala Beach, Phuket | 30 mins from major golf courses |

faqs.q: How close is Cafe del Mar Phuket on Kamala Beach to Phuket's top golf courses?
faqs.a: Cafe del Mar on Kamala Beach sits just 15 minutes south of Laguna Golf Phuket, 20 minutes from Red Mountain Golf Club, and 30 minutes from Blue Canyon Country Club, making it Phuket's most convenient west-coast post-round beach club.

faqs.q: Which Phuket luxury resorts are closest to Cafe del Mar Kamala?
faqs.a: Amanpuri (10 minutes north on Surin/Pansea headland) and Banyan Tree Phuket (15 minutes north in Bang Tao / Laguna) offer effortless chauffeured transfers to and from Cafe del Mar.

faqs.q: What time should a golf group book a VIP poolside daybed or cabana at Cafe del Mar Phuket?
faqs.a: We recommend arriving at 4:30 PM after your morning round at Red Mountain or Blue Canyon to enjoy sunset wood-fired tapas and Balearic house beats through the 8:30 PM beach fire-dancing spectacle.
